result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: incorrect bottom navigation active state showing Profile instead of Home, inconsistent wishlist button styling, and truncated/inconsistent text formatting in restaurant cards.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows Profile as active (green) while the screen displays the Home feed content; Home should be highlighted instead
issues.suggestion: Update bottom navigation selected state to highlight Home when on the home feed

issues.description: Wishlist heart buttons in Popular right now section are inconsistent: Tokumaru Ramen Bar heart has no background circle while the pizza card below has a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent wishlist button style with the same background, size and contrast across all cards

issues.description: Third card in Fastest near you shows truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' and time badges use inconsistent spacing '20-30 min' vs '20-30 min'
issues.suggestion: Standardize time badge formatting and ensure truncated names use ellipsis or become fully visible when scrolled
